title: Index loops in the operators of SlimVector and unrolled 3x3 products of Matrix3D
author: Claude-JG
description: Recommendations L4, L5 of docs/dev/design/linalgBenchmark.md: the operators + - * of SlimVector loop over iterators of the result and the cross product is constructed from an initializer list (SlimVector<3> + 7 times, the cross product 2.4 times Eigen); Matrix3D * Matrix3D and Matrix3D * Vector3D go through the checked operator() (2.2 times the prototype). Plain index loops over the compile-time size, the cross product written into the data, and the 3x3 products unrolled over the data pointers, the order of the sums unchanged (revision2026c step RG5.1.9).
releaseNotes: SlimVector operators as index loops over the compile-time size, the cross product written into the data, Matrix3D * Matrix3D and Matrix3D * Vector3D unrolled with the same order of sums: SlimVector + and the cross product 2.3 times, Matrix3D * Matrix3D 2.2-2.8 times faster.
